reuse_all.note: Keep every stored semantic value after the document update.

lineage_only.note: Recompute every semantic cell reached by exact version lineage; this is not a reproduction of either system.

uniform_clean.note: Transfer only uniform sample selection from SVC; omit its aggregate estimator and outlier index, and score the maintained filter and join directly.

ttl_control.note: Prioritize the oldest stored source version.

edit_control.note: Prioritize relative document-length change without reading the new semantic value.

proxy_priority.note: Transfer proxy-guided evaluation from SUPG and rank stored prediction uncertainty; this is not a reproduction of SUPG.

influence_only.note: Rank only by the number of current main-namespace links in the materialized join relation.

change_only_control.note: Prioritize cells whose fixed operator input signature changed; break ties by cell identifier.

change_random_control.note: Restrict calls to changed input signatures and choose uniformly among those cells.

ttl_x_influence.note: Rank by stored-value age times current link degree.

edit_x_influence.note: Rank by relative document-length change times current link degree.

proxy_x_influence.note: Multiply stored prediction uncertainty by current link degree; no external system is reproduced.

change_x_influence_ours.note: Use exact fixed-input invariance, then minimize the worst-case residual join-row error by link degree.

hindsight_filter.note: Read the hidden transition before selection and prioritize every changed label.

hindsight_join.note: Read the hidden transition and its current join degree before selection.
